description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/2924/25 dated 6.1.2026 for Single storey front extension incorporating porch; Two storey side extension, Conversion of garage to a habitable room; Alterations to roof to form front dormer; External alterations (Demolition of side dormer)
decision_conditions:
<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no
window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of
the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted
shall match those used in the existing building.&nbsp;</p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the details submitted under application reference <span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">PL/1064/26</span>, and that were approved in writing by, the local planning authority.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/2924/25.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:  01; 02; 03; 04; 05; 06; 07; 08; 09 (dated 15/09/2026); 10(dated 15/09/2026); 11(dated 15/09/2026); 12; 13; 14; 15; 16; Reasonable Exception Statement; Flood Risk Assessment.
